+import typing
+
+from sqlalchemy.engine.row import Row
+
+
+class Record(Row):
+    """
+    A SQLAlchemy :class:`~sqlalchemy.engine.row.Row` that also exposes the
+    mapping-style interface of :class:`databases.interfaces.Record`.
+
+    SQLAlchemy >= 2.0 removed the mapping-style accessors (``row["key"]``,
+    ``row.keys()``, ``dict(row)``) from :class:`Row`, keeping only
+    ``row._mapping`` and tuple/attribute access.  This subclass restores the
+    ``Record`` behaviour expected by ``databases`` consumers while preserving
+    the underlying row semantics.
+    """
+
+    __slots__ = ()
+
+    def __getitem__(self, key: typing.Any) -> typing.Any:
+        if isinstance(key, (int, slice)):
+            return super().__getitem__(key)
+        return self._mapping[key]
+
+    def keys(self) -> typing.Any:
+        return self._mapping.keys()
+
+    def values(self) -> typing.Any:
+        return self._mapping.values()
